newsitem.title: USA: Student Loan Marketing sets meeting date.
newsitem.headline: Student Loan Marketing sets meeting date.

text.p: Student Loan Marketing Association said on Monday it has mailed proxy materials for a special shareholder meeting set for May 15 for a vote to privatize the company.
Sallie Mae's reorganization will involve a share exchange between the company and a new holding company and a slate of directors for the board of the holding company, it said.
The special meeting of shareholders for which proxies are being solicited is scheduled for May 15, 1997, 1000 EST, at The Ritz-Carlton, Tysons Corner, 1700 Tysons Blvd., McLean, Va.
Sallie Mae said the majority of its board recommends approving the privatization plan by signing and returning the blue proxy cards.
A minority of Sallie Mae's directors are aiming to reject the reorganization plan and are soliciting proxies for their own slate of directors.

The privatization plan provides for a transition from a government-sponsored enterprise to a fully privatized company, enables the company to consider new strategic options, retains its management and cuts its exposure to political risks, Sallie Mae said.
